text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Tuesday its board will consider on December 4 the spin-off to shareholders of the shares of Tele-Communications International Inc and Liberty Media Corp.

The company said the board will consider at a regular meeting submitting to the Internal Revenue Service a request for a tax ruling regarding the tax-free spin-off of Tele-Communications International to shareholders of Tele-Communications Inc group common stock and Liberty Media to shareholders of Liberty Media group common stock.

The company said that if the board were to approve either or both of these filings for a tax-free ruling, the ultimate decision on whether to spin off the units would be subject to board approval of specific terms, a favourable tax ruling, receipt of a no-action letter from the Securities and Exchange Commission, and other regulatory and contractual approvals.
